$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (connectors-job-board-multiposting). Indeed pulls vacancies from a feed instead of taking a push: the dormant Indeed source, a feed source whose call answers "published in feed" without sending anything, the mapping from humaniq's Vacancy to one job of Indeed's XML job feed, and the anonymous feed endpoint jobfeeds/indeed.xml that lists the published vacancies offered to Indeed as that feed (design D2 and D3).

objects.name: Indeed vacancy feed
objects.description: Indeed reads vacancies from the feed jobfeeds/indeed.xml instead of taking a push, so a call to this source sends nothing: it answers "published in feed" with the feed URL as its link, and the humaniq flow records the posting as placed. Before enabling, set the location to this instance's feed URL, https://<your-nextcloud>/index.php/apps/integriq/api/endpoint/jobfeeds/indeed.xml, and register that URL with Indeed; Indeed's terms for employer job feeds apply before going live.

objects.name: humaniq Vacancy to an Indeed feed job
objects.description: One humaniq Vacancy as one <job> of Indeed's XML job feed (Indeed XML job feed guidelines). Before use, fill `company` with the employer name and `url` with the vacancy page, for example https://werken.example.nl/vacatures/{{ vacancyId }}. The vacancy id is the reference number, so Indeed keeps one job per vacancy across feed reads. No applicant data is ever mapped. The vacancy carries no place, so city stays empty and the country is NL; Indeed's posting of an employer's jobs requires the feed URL to be registered with Indeed.

mapping.title: {{ title }}
mapping.experience: {{ minExperienceYears is defined and minExperienceYears is not null ? minExperienceYears ~ '+ years' : '' }}
mapping.expirationdate: {{ closingDate is defined and closingDate ? closingDate|date('Y-m-d') : '' }}

objects.name: Indeed vacancy feed shape
objects.description: Wraps the vacancies mapped to Indeed jobs in the root of Indeed's XML job feed: <source> with the publisher and one <job> per vacancy. Before use, fill `publisher` with the employer name and `publisherurl` with its careers site.

objects.name: Indeed feed job
objects.description: Runs the jobboard-indeed mapping over each vacancy of the feed, so only the fields of an Indeed job leave the register.

objects.name: Indeed feed shape
objects.description: On the list answer, replaces the paging envelope with the root of Indeed's XML job feed.

objects.name: Indeed vacancy feed
objects.description: Indeed's XML job feed of humaniq's published vacancies whose channels include indeed, anonymously: a public list of public vacancies (ADR-091 decision 5), throttled, without applicant data. Register the URL /index.php/apps/integriq/api/endpoint/jobfeeds/indeed.xml with Indeed; the .xml path answers as XML without an Accept header. The Indeed partner terms apply before going live.
